quality.review_scope: Independent scoped scientific quick audit accepted main PDF pp.1–4 for the packaged AgCl-to-Ag route, five TEOS silica-shell branches, each aminosilane/QD adsorption branch, and Figures 1–3 structure/optical outcomes. Main p.5 is references only. No matched local SI PDF was available and no SI-derived values are claimed. Commercial QD synthesis/ligands, final dispersion workup and author-estimated attachment counts retain the recorded caveats.
missing_fields: Commercial Sigma-Aldrich Lumidot CdSe/ZnS QD synthesis, size and surface ligand identity are outside this source.
AgNP dispersion concentration before shell growth and final reaction pH are not reported.
The five final QD-attached complexes are not separately imaged by TEM in this paper; Figure 2 measures their Ag/SiO2 precursors.

QD attachment count (~100 per particle) is author-estimated from aminosilane concentration, not directly counted; final dispersions were not purified of ~900 unadsorbed QDs per particle by that estimate.
Figure 3 fluorescence intensity is qualitative relative to QDs; no source numeric peak-ratio table is reported.
conflicts: Main p.3 direct comparison says 24, 31 and 38 nm shells give stronger fluorescence than free QDs; later same-page wording says enhancement at shell thickness >24 nm. The 24 nm measured comparison is retained without deriving a strict threshold.

Main p.2 says Ag/SiO2 was centrifuged and washed, whereas p.3 explicitly says the later Ag/SiO2-QD optical dispersions were not collected/washed to remove excess QDs. These workups apply to different stages and are not merged.
